tools.name: get_public_article
tools.description: Read-only lookup of one published article by its canonical https://colinmichaels.com/blog/... URL. Returns citation metadata and an excerpt, never drafts or full private CMS content.

canonicalUrl.description: The canonical ColinMichaels.com article URL with no query string or fragment.

tools.name: get_public_topic_guide
tools.description: Read-only lookup of one canonical ColinMichaels.com topic guide. Returns the guide description, canonical URL, and supported search terms.

tools.name: search_public_content
tools.description: Read-only search of published ColinMichaels.com articles and public topic guides. Returns at most five canonical results with citation metadata. Do not use for drafts, private CMS data, or write actions.

query.description: A focused public-content search query between 2 and 160 characters.
